name: multica
title: Multica
description: Search, create, and triage Multica issues, and keep an eye on your agents and runtimes
author: adam_engebretson

commands.name: search-issues
commands.title: Search Issues
commands.subtitle: Multica
commands.description: Browse open issues and search across all issues, then change status, priority, or assignee, or comment

commands.name: create-issue
commands.title: Create Issue
commands.subtitle: Multica
commands.description: Create an issue and assign it to a teammate or an agent

commands.name: delegate-task
commands.title: Delegate Task
commands.subtitle: Multica
commands.description: Describe the work and an agent writes and files the issue for you (Multica's Agent mode)

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: My Inbox
commands.subtitle: Multica
commands.description: Your Multica notifications and the open issues assigned to you

commands.name: inbox-menu-bar
commands.title: Inbox Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Multica
commands.description: Unread inbox count in the menu bar, broken down by workspace

commands.name: inbox-counts
commands.title: Inbox Counts
commands.subtitle: Multica
commands.description: Keeps each workspace's unread count in this command's subtitle. Run it to open My Inbox.

commands.name: agents
commands.title: Agents & Runtimes
commands.subtitle: Multica
commands.description: Check agent status, recent runs, and which runtimes are online

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Optional. A Multica personal access token (Settings → Tokens). Leave empty to reuse the login from the Multica desktop app or CLI (~/.multica).

preferences.name: profile
preferences.title: CLI Profile
preferences.description: Optional. Which ~/.multica profile to read when no API token is set, e.g. desktop-api.multica.ai. Defaults to the main config, then the most recently used profile.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: API URL
preferences.description: Optional. Override the API server for self-hosted Multica. Defaults to the profile's server or https://api.multica.ai.

preferences.name: appUrl
preferences.title: Web App URL
preferences.description: Optional. Override the web app URL used for Open in Browser links.

preferences.name: demoMode
preferences.title: Demo Mode
preferences.label: Show sample data
preferences.description: Use built-in sample workspaces, issues, and agents instead of your Multica account. Nothing is sent to Multica.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
